end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group of 10 to estimate a larger collection, and Ananya explained that 4 groups of 10 make 40. They mixed up counting groups with counting all the objects, and also thought spreading objects out could mean there are more; neither mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, make small groups of 10 with buttons or bottle caps and ask Ananya to estimate the total before counting.
